slides.texte_overlay:
hobbies that make your
evenings better than any screen

evening sketching

keep a small sketchbook by the sofa and draw one object from your day. your drawings won't be perfect, but an hour with a pencil feels calmer than any feed.

slow cooking

cook one new recipe on a weeknight with music on and no rush. chopping, tasting and stirring slowly is a gentle and lovely way to let the whole working day go.

learning by lamplight

spend 5 minutes each evening learning one beautiful thing: a myth, a planet, a painting. it's far more satisfying than an hour of scrolling past strangers.
slides.texte_sophia:
learning by lamplight

i used to scroll until midnight. now i spend 5 minutes each evening on one lesson in the Sophia app, a myth or a planet, and my evenings finally feel like they're mine.

slides.texte_overlay:
puzzles

keep a jigsaw puzzle on a table and add a few pieces every night. it gives your hands and mind something quiet to do, and finishing it feels so satisfying.

evening walks

walk around your neighbourhood after dinner, just as the lights come on. cool air and quiet streets help you sleep better than any late night scrolling.
